description: Schema reference for PerfGazer report views. Each view corresponds to a SQL temporary view created by JsonSink.

views.name: job
views.description: Job-level execution report. One row per completed Spark job.

fields.name: jobStartTime
fields.description: Epoch timestamp when the job started

fields.name: jobEndTime
fields.description: Epoch timestamp when the job ended

fields.name: stages
fields.description: List of stage IDs in this job

views.name: sql
views.description: SQL query execution report with SQL plans (logical, physical, ...) and their node metrics. One row per completed SQL execution.

fields.name: nodes
fields.type: ARRAY<STRUCT<sqlId: BIGINT, jobName: STRING, nodeName: STRING, coordinates: STRING, metrics: MAP<STRING, STRING>, isLeaf: BOOLEAN, parentNodeName: STRING>>
fields.description: Physical plan nodes with execution metrics

fields.name: sqlId
fields.description: SQL execution this node belongs to

fields.name: jobName
fields.description: Name of the job that triggered this SQL

fields.name: coordinates
fields.description: Dot-separated position in the plan tree, e.g. '0.1.2'

fields.name: isLeaf
fields.description: True if this node has no children in the plan tree

fields.name: parentNodeName
fields.description: Name of the parent operator in the plan tree

views.name: stage
views.description: Stage-level execution report. One row per completed Spark stage.

fields.name: stageSubmissionTime
fields.description: Epoch timestamp when the stage was submitted

fields.name: stageCompletionTime
fields.description: Epoch timestamp when the stage completed

views.name: task
views.description: Task-level execution metrics. One row per completed Spark task.

fields.name: taskLaunchTime
fields.description: Epoch timestamp when the task was launched

fields.name: taskFinishTime
fields.description: Epoch timestamp when the task finished

fields.name: executorRunTime
fields.description: Time spent running the task on the executor

fields.name: executorCpuTime
fields.description: CPU time consumed by the executor

fields.name: executorDeserializeTime
fields.description: Time to deserialize the task on the executor

fields.name: executorDeserializeCpuTime
fields.description: CPU time spent deserializing the task

fields.name: resultSize
fields.description: Size of the serialized task result

fields.name: jvmGCTime
fields.description: Time spent in JVM garbage collection

fields.name: fetchWaitTime
fields.description: Time spent waiting for shuffle fetch

fields.name: localBlocksFetched
fields.description: Number of local blocks fetched during shuffle

fields.name: localBytesRead
fields.description: Bytes read from local shuffle blocks

fields.name: remoteBlocksFetched
fields.description: Number of remote blocks fetched during shuffle

fields.name: remoteBytesRead
fields.description: Bytes read from remote shuffle blocks

fields.name: remoteBytesReadToDisk
fields.description: Remote shuffle bytes read to disk

fields.name: remoteRequestsDuration
fields.description: Time spent on remote shuffle requests
